description: This PHP file defines a database migration class for upgrading the OrangeHRM HRM system to version 4.3. It includes code to insert data into module and configuration tables, set permissions, retrieve data group and screen IDs, link data groups to screens, and create a new database table for marketplace addons if it doesn't exist.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database schema migration to upgrade OrangeHRM to version 4.3, including data insertion, permission setup, and conditional table creation.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps, including data insertion into module and configuration tables, permission setup, fetching IDs, linking data groups to screens, and creating the 'ohrm_marketplace_addon' table if it does not exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for this migration, which is '4.3'.
